ahmadhcj07: They issued Bram Ahmadhcj a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lock of hair in a matchbox in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Bram Ahmadhcj was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F11. Bram Ahmadhcj has learned to walk bent double.
